text:
If you're waiting on that promised sunshine, it's on its way but taking its time. That mostly cloudy start with the lingering fog is set to break up through the afternoon, clearing toward a high near 80 with a light north breeze. Should be a solid stretch out there for the back half of the day, and the lake's in good shape too, waves a foot or less and water sitting at a comfortable 73.

Tonight stays easy, partly cloudy and dropping to around 61, nothing to plan around. The next thing on the radar is Wednesday afternoon, when a shower or a rumble of thunder becomes possible, especially after 2pm. It's not a washout, just keep half an eye on the sky if you've got outdoor plans into the evening. Good waterfront window today through sunset; I'd have any Wednesday plans done by early afternoon just in case.
